name: Live ROI interval below zero
test: upper bound of the weekly-block 95% interval on live ROI < 0
statistic: weekly-block bootstrap of mean pnl (1,000 draws)
why: negative ROI is confirmed, not noise

name: Signal decay
test: live signal→pnl rank correlation < 0 with an interval excluding zero, and the backtest correlation was > 0
statistic: Spearman ρ on live settled picks vs the same statistic on the backtest
why: the model's own disagreement stopped predicting the outcome

name: Drawdown past the stake limit
test: cumulative live pnl < −stake_limit, where stake_limit = backtest units at a −5-cent adverse price move
statistic: cumulative sum of live pnl vs the stress-tested backtest limit
why: the live record has lost more than the backtest ever said it could

name: Live win rate contradicts the backtest
test: live win rate < backtest win rate − 2 standard errors (pooled)
why: the strategy is describing a different population than the backtest

name: Settlement integrity failure
test: a settled live pick lacks a price, a timestamp, or an official settlement URL
statistic: field check on every live pick
why: no strategy stays funded on unverifiable evidence

name: Staleness
test: no settled live pick for 28 days while the strategy still fires
statistic: date arithmetic on freeze_seq and kickoff
why: a strategy that cannot be settled cannot be judged
